```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(SEtools)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(plgINS)
  library(viridis)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(scales)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggsci)
  library(cowplot)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(ggnewscale)
  library(ggbreak) 
})
source("../../../00_functions/plotVolcano_new.R")
```




# set colors
```{r}
show_col(pal_uchicago("default")(9))
red <- pal_uchicago("default")(3)[1]
grey <- pal_uchicago("default")(3)[2]
yellow <- pal_uchicago("default")(3)[3]
blue <- pal_uchicago("default")(9)[5]
```


# Load Data
```{r}
se <- readRDS("../../data/SE.dea.Gene.salmon.raw.rds")
```


# dea 1229
```{r}
#no label
dea1229 <- rowData(se)[["DEA.ind.Ctrl-MiR"]]
dea1229$names <- row.names(dea1229)
dea1229$dir <- ifelse(dea1229$logFC < 0, "downr","upr")
dea1229$symbol <- sapply(strsplit(row.names(dea1229),"\\."),"[",2)
```


```{r}
# plot Volcano
p <- plotVolcano_new(df = dea1229 , text.size = 12, sig = 0.05,log.base = 10, anno = NULL, colors = c(yellow,blue,grey),
                 xlim_min = -3, xlim_max = 3,ybreaks = c(0, 5, 15, 25, 35),yaxis_mode = c("FDR")) + ggtitle("miR-1229-3p (10nM)")

ggsave(p,filename = "../Figure_Output/Volcanos/dea1229_10nM.pdf", width = 5, height = 4)
```

```{r}
#Source data Fig. 6a)
write.csv(dea1229,"../../../12_SourceData/Fig6/Fig_6a.csv")
```
